## Problem

A clear and concise description of the problem you're trying to solve. Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Research Context

If this change affects scoring or compression logic, please:
- Reference the relevant section of the [paper](https://kompress.vaked.dev/paper/main.pdf)
- Include before/after benchmark numbers if available
- Explain any tradeoffs

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or code examples about the feature request here.
